name: MAGA Inc.
summary: The main pro-Trump super PAC, set up six weeks before the 2022 midterms. In the 2024 cycle it raised about $410.5 million and spent more than $456.8 million, mostly backing Trump and attacking Biden, Harris, and in the primary DeSantis and Haley. It kept raising from megadonors after the election, passed $400 million in cash in 2026, then spent about $277 million in the midterms, much of it through affiliated groups such as No Going Back PAC.
